## moobile 应用开发：从零一个应用、加一个页面 (moobile-app-development)
- 用 moobile 写应用侧代码（不改库）的入口：TEA 四件套 + 单导出 app()、首帧入口、@html DSL…
- 原文: skills/moobile-app-development/SKILL.md
- 事件与订阅：要"真实值"就得挑对通道：skills/moobile-app-development/references/events-and-subs.md
- 宿主侧接入、产物搬运与能力边界：skills/moobile-app-development/references/host-and-capabilities.md
- 页面、滚动容器与长列表：skills/moobile-app-development/references/pages-and-lists.md
- 应用骨架：模块、出口名字、首帧入口、update 是纯的：skills/moobile-app-development/references/structure.md
- 样式：唯一通道是 @style，没有 CSS：skills/moobile-app-development/references/styles.md

- 注册：一次调用、两种形状，以及顺序与幂等：skills/moobile-custom-component/references/registration.md

- 在 moobile 仓库里改库本体的操作规程：一条能力该进库 / 生成器 / 应用的三条判据、改动与必须跑的验证之间的…

- 改完必须跑什么（隐藏耦合）：skills/moobile-library-development/references/gates-coupling.md
- 发版顺序与禁区：skills/moobile-library-development/references/release-and-rules.md
- vendor fork、宿主包与生成物：skills/moobile-library-development/references/vendor-host-and-generated.md
- 写东西的规矩与工具链：skills/moobile-library-development/references/writing-and-tooling.md

## moobile-pitfalls —— 「不报错但错」的门禁 (moobile-pitfalls)
- moobile 里「编译过了、也渲染了，但行为或外观不对」时先看的那份门禁：最贵的六条雷与禁区；逐条清单在 refer…
- 原文: skills/moobile-pitfalls/SKILL.md
- 两条"通道"：第三方组件库与画布：skills/moobile-pitfalls/references/channels.md
- 事件：点了没反应，而且什么都不说：skills/moobile-pitfalls/references/events.md
- 平台与数据：静默给错值的那一类最贵：skills/moobile-pitfalls/references/platform.md
- 样式：写了不报错，就是没效果：skills/moobile-pitfalls/references/styles.md
- 标签与布局：机械迁移最先撞的几处：skills/moobile-pitfalls/references/tags-and-layout.md

- registerLibrary：一个决定，四个面：skills/moobile-react-library/references/register-library.md
